dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: I'm meeting a friend at the mall for dinner. Can you suggest an Italian place?

dialogue_prefix.speaker: assistant
dialogue_prefix.text: Sure. Any budget or dietary needs I should know about?

dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: My friend is vegetarian, so we need vegetarian options.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: assistant
dialogue_prefix.text: Noted: vegetarian-friendly Italian near the mall.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: And let's keep it to $35 per person at most.

dialogue_prefix.speaker: user
dialogue_prefix.text: Which one should we go to?

evaluation_only.contrast_note: Budget 30 vs 35: one valid restaurant vs two. B checks the system just picks one of several valid options instead of asking the user to choose.

predefined_clarification_answers._unsupported: I don't have a preference on that.
predefined_clarification_answers._multi_question: Sorry, one thing at a time - what did you want to know first?
